snippet.title: CRAVE - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Ceaseless hunger draws you yet a bit closer to the gates of Foghorn. Devour men and beasts alike to acquire a wide array of combat abilities. Through shadows and mold, track down the paling memories of this bygone kingdom, all in a classic hand-drawn action platformer.

Wishlist Crave on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826400/CRAVE/

Meet the Dev (Hang The Eyelids)
Website: https://crave-game.com/
X: https://x.com/Nekrik

#indiegame #metroidvania
